prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality wide BADASS sale banner with a smooth sky-blue gradient background fading to pale mint. On the left, place small white text 'BADASS' at the top, then a blue word 'SALE', then an oversized royal-blue '60%' dominating the composition. Attach a small cream tag reading 'UP TO' with a yellow string near the top-right of the zero. Along the lower left, add black text 'END SEASON 2026' followed by smaller black text 'TOÀN BỘ HỆ THỐNG TỪ 17/07'. On the right, place a photorealistic smiling young Asian male model wearing a white polo shirt, light trousers, and a wristwatch, standing with one hand in pocket. Add a diagonal yellow sale ribbon in the top-right corner and a long repeating yellow bottom ribbon with 'SALE BADASS SALE BADASS SALE BADASS'. Technical style: photorealistic model-led sale banner combined with bold graphic typography, bright studio-commercial lighting, high-key retail finish, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
